name: Sadducee Opposer
background: An elite Sadducean who denies resurrection, angels, and spirits. Opposes the movement.

genericReactions.physical: Material objects are of no consequence to the Law.
genericReactions.testimonial: The man was a threat to the Temple and our arrangement with Rome. That is all.
genericReactions.digital: We have the Law of Moses. We need no other records.
genericReactions.environmental: The location is irrelevant. The threat was real.
genericReactions.analytical: We do not deal in the superstitions of the Pharisees. There is no resurrection.
genericReactions.prophecy: Prophecy is for the excitable masses. We deal in law and order.
